title: workflowlog
description: Note Single-valued navigation properties (bind with <name>@odata.bind, expand with $expand): asyncoperationid_asyncoperation, asyncoperationid_processsession, childworkflowinstanceid_asyncoperation, childworkflowinstanceid_processsession, createdby, createdonbehalfby, ExpiredProcess_asyncoperationid, modifiedby, modifiedonbehalfby, NewProcess_asyncoperationid, owningbusinessunit, owningteam, TranslationProcess_asyncoperationid.

activityname.description: Name of the activity which the process step is currently processing.

completedon.description: Date and time when the operation was completed.

createdon.description: Date and time when the process log entry was created.

duration.description: Duration between completed on and started on, used by business process flow.

errortext.description: The string representation of the error.

inputs.description: Inputs required by the workflow step.

interactionactivityresult.description: String specifying the result of an interaction activity.

iterationcount.description: The iteration count for the action when in a do until loop.

modifiedon.description: Date and time when the process log entry was last modified.

outputs.description: Outputs generated by the workflow step.

repetitioncount.description: The count of repetitions of the action when in a loop.

repetitionid.description: The string representation of the repetition and iteration / level of the action.

startedon.description: Date and time when the operation was started.

status.description: Status of the process step for which process log record has been created: In Progress, Successfully Completed, or Failed.

workflowlogid.description: Unique identifier of the process log entry.

_asyncoperationid_value.description: Unique identifier of the parent record.

_childworkflowinstanceid_value.description: Unique identifier of the system job.

_createdby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who created the process log entry.

_createdonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who created the process log.

_modifiedby_value.description: Unique identifier of the user who last modified the process log entry.

_modifiedonbehalfby_value.description: Unique identifier of the delegate user who last modified the process log.

_owningbusinessunit_value.description: Unique identifier of the business unit that owns the process.

_owningteam_value.description: Unique identifier of the team who owns the process log.
